summary.ko: 결정에 필요한 변수와 중립적인 질문·응답 선택지·분석 계획을 설계합니다.
summary.en: Design a concise survey with neutral questions and a clear plan for interpreting responses.

exclusions: Sending surveys or collecting live responses

required_inputs.description: Decision to support, target population, and research questions
Survey length, distribution context, required measures, and privacy constraints

workflow.instruction: Map each research question to a construct and explain how the response will inform a decision.
Write neutral, single-purpose questions with appropriate answer scales and non-overlapping options.
Order questions to reduce priming and burden; include skip logic and optional responses only where needed.
Create an analysis plan and pilot checklist, identifying sampling and nonresponse limitations.

deliverables.name: Survey draft
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each item includes question, type, options, required status, logic, and purpose

deliverables.name: Analysis and pilot plan
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Explains interpretation, quality checks, and sampling limitations

limitations: A well-written survey does not guarantee a representative sample.
Do not reuse proprietary standardized instruments without checking permission.
permission_boundaries: Do not publish the form, recruit participants, collect sensitive data, or offer incentives.
Avoid unnecessary identity fields and disclose intended data use in the draft.
